title: Search Hold on Lost FBN Units by Size Tier
content:
Units written off as lost in warehouse in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) are still being searched for while their adjustment lies inside the warehouse-loss search hold, and are not yet claimable. The length of the hold follows the size tier recorded on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU.

**Provision.** The warehouse-loss search hold is a span of the small-item search hold of 2 months when the latest inbound receipt of the SKU records the small standard size tier, and of the oversize search hold of 0 months when it records the large bulky or extra large size tier. A SKU whose latest inbound receipt records the large standard size tier takes no different hold under this provision.

A record lies inside a hold of a given number of months when fewer than that number of whole months have passed from its date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month; a hold of 0 months therefore holds no adjustment, and every lost-in-warehouse adjustment of a large bulky or extra large SKU is outside the hold.

## Which receipt decides

Only the latest inbound receipt of the SKU decides the tier. Example (hypothetical): a SKU received as large standard in January and as small standard in April takes the small-item hold of 2 months from April onwards.

## Inside or outside a 2-month hold (handling date 20 May, hypothetical adjustments of a small standard SKU)

| Adjustment date | Whole months to 20 May | Inside the 2-month hold |
|---|---|---|
| 21 March | 1 | yes: not yet claimable |
| 20 March | 2 | no |
| 15 May | 0 | yes: not yet claimable |

The same three adjustments of an extra large SKU are all outside the hold of 0 months.
